text:
maria: Quick sync — thinking of running a small outreach UX experiment for the DP beta. goal: reduce drop-off in the invite -> onboarding funnel and get higher-quality feedback. thoughts?

sam: +1. do we have a baseline funnel conversion rate? numbers will shape the experiment.

maria: baseline is ~28% complete onboarding within 7 days from invite (last cohort). we want 45% for this pilot.

raj: UX idea: split test two invite flows — A) short product-first invite with 1-click signup, B) longer briefing + onboarding checklist (for power users).

taylor: Also test incentive framing. In past we offered $500 credits. what if we offer tiered credits + exclusive feature preview for top reporters? might drive sustained engagement.

casey: Suggest recruiting 10 partners (mix of PLG startups and one enterprise). staggered start weeks so we can iterate on onboarding copy between waves.

maria: proposed timeline: wave1 (weeks 1–2): 3 partners, wave2 (weeks 3–4): 4 partners, wave3 (weeks 5–6): 3 partners. each wave = 2-week active feedback sprint.

sam: For instrumentation: we need per-invite track (utm-like), onboarding step events, prompt-set run counts, and first-feedback submission timestamp. can we add token-level cost tags for partner accounts?

ops-bot: deploy queued: analytics-tracking/v2 will be ready for QA tomorrow at 11:00 UTC.

maria: success metrics (primary): onboarding completion % within 7 days, median time-to-first-feedback, and number of actionable issues per partner (>3 = good). secondary: average session length, retention at 30 days.

raj: Feedback capture UX: embed a 1-click issue reporter in-console + optional short survey. keep surveys <5 questions, use severity tags (blocking, major, minor).

taylor: On incentives, propose: base $250 credits + milestone $250 when partner submits 3 actionable bug reports and completes an NPS-style survey. highlight top contributors with a badge in console.

jenna: legal note: make sure the incentive terms are explicit about data sharing and IP. add a short T&Cs checkbox during onboarding and offer an opt-out for case studies.

casey: For recruiting messaging, draft variants: short technical pitch vs research collaboration pitch. I'll write two email templates we can A/B.

maria: sample outreach snippet (for A flow):
```
Hey there — we'd love your team to try a private beta of Redwood Dedicated for inference cost experiments. 1-click setup, $250 credits, 2-week feedback sprint. Interested?
```

sam: We should pre-seed prompt tests and a short evaluation harness so partners can run something meaningful in day 1. I'll create a repo with examples.

maria: negotiation strategy: let partners pick one of three data policies (logs retained for 7d, 30d with opt-in, or customer-managed logs via VPC). call this out in the invite — avoids back-and-forth.

raj: Good idea. also include an onboarding checklist visible in invite: setup, run sample, submit 1st feedback, schedule 30-min sync.

maria: ops question — can Dedicated team provision trial capacity without SLA? sam?

sam: yes we can carve a small dev pool for trials. no SLA, but we'll monitor and set clear expectations in invite.

ops-bot: annotate: trial-pool tag applied to partner accounts at provisioning.

maria: follow-ups: @casey please draft the two outreach templates by EOD Tue. @raj can you design the in-console reporter quick mocks by Wed? @sam and @ops-bot coordinate instrumentation + trial pool provisioning. @jenna to draft short T&Cs. we'll reconvene Fri to finalize list and send invites next week. :sparkles:

taylor: :thumbsup: leaning into tiered incentives and visible badges — should help sustain reporting beyond week 1.

casey: I'll drop the templates in the doc and ping here when done.

maria: perfect. goal = learn three things: (1) which invite copy and incentive combo maximizes high-quality onboarding, (2) friction points in early setup, (3) what proportion of partners produce actionable regressions vs general feedback. if we get those, we can scale recruitment and standardize the beta kit.

sam: sounds good. small ask — let's limit initial beta to use-cases that exercise long-context inference and batching (where the runtime recommendations matter). that will give us the best signals for Optimize.

maria: noted. thanks all — will post an updated checklist after casey + raj deliver.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: #product standup Fri 10:00 UTC (auto-post).
